title: Shani Yadav v. U.P. Power Corporation Limited and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Siddhartha Varma and Syed Qamar Hasan Rizvi, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed as settled under government scheme
headnote: Writ dismissed. On counsel's statement that the petitioner had settled under the Government Order dated 4 November 2023, the Court held that no further order was required. Compliance with Clause 8.1 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 and the assessment of Rs. 9,19,826 were not decided.
facts: Shani Yadav filed a writ against U.P. Power Corporation Limited and another over an order dated 11 August 2023 for Rs. 9,19,826, saying Clause 8.1 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 had not been followed. On 7 November 2023 the Court directed the Executive Engineer to explain that calculation on affidavit and restrained coercive action until the next date. On 7 December 2023 counsel for the department stated that the petitioner had settled the dispute under a Government scheme dated 4 November 2023.

holding_units.topic: dismissal on settlement without code construction
holding_units.holding: Counsel for the Electricity Department stated that the petitioner had settled the matter under the scheme in the Government Order dated 4 November 2023. The Court held that no further order was required and dismissed the writ, without construing Clause 8.1 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 or examining the sum of Rs. 9,19,826.

principle_tags.application: The petition ended on the department's statement of settlement under the Government Order dated 4 November 2023. Clause 8.1 was only the petitioner's contention at the earlier listing and was not construed.

not_decided.point: Whether the order dated 11 August 2023 complied with Clause 8.1 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and how Rs. 9,19,826 was calculated
not_decided.note: Not examined once counsel stated that the petitioner had settled under the Government Order dated 4 November 2023.
